notes: rockyou.txt ships gzip-compressed on Kali - gunzip it once. directory-list-2.3-medium is the default web-content list for gobuster/ffuf/feroxbuster. For AD user brute/spray, xato-net usernames + a policy-filtered password list beats rockyou. Generate target-specific lists with cewl (site words) or username-anarchy (name permutations).

recommended.note: Scrape target site words into a custom list.
Uses Hashcat rule engine with --stdout to print (rather than crack) every rule-mutated variant of a wordlist, producing a new expanded list.

name: Wordlists - Go-To Paths (SecLists + Kali)
description: The wordlists you actually reach for in CPTS, by task, with their on-disk paths on Kali/Parrot after installing seclists. Saves guessing paths during content discovery, brute forcing and cracking. apt install seclists puts these under /usr/share/seclists.
